entities.name: Raphaël Marie Ze
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Raphaël Marie Ze was the Roman Catholic bishop of the Diocese of Sangmélima, Cameroon. Ordained to the priesthood in 1962, Ze became bishop of the Sangmélima in 1997 and retired in 2008.
